name: Netlify
description: Netlify's hosted server creates and deploys sites and manages their settings, environment variables and forms.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (netlify-mcp.netlify.app) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
